results.title: Fellow Ode Gen 2 review
results.content: The Fellow Ode Gen 2 is a flat-burr grinder made for filter coffee.

results.title: Baratza Encore ESP review
results.content: The Baratza Encore ESP is a conical-burr grinder that covers espresso and filter.
